title: Standing Firm in a World Gone Mad
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he tackles the current state of the world and encourages believers to stand firm on the Word of God in the face of chaos and confusion. With a focus on Bible prophecy and its role in preparing us for what's to come, Pastor Zehner reminds us that even in the midst of darkness, God's glory is still displayed in our lives. Don't miss this powerful message that will leave you with a renewed sense of hope and purpose in these uncertain times.
